title: FBR Updates Property Valuation Rates for Islamabad and Abbottabad
excerpt: The Federal Board of Revenue has established new property valuation rates for rural areas in Islamabad and for Abbottabad.
body_html:
The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has announced updated property valuation rates. The new rates apply to rural areas within the Islamabad Capital Territory as well as to Abbottabad.

Property valuations in the rural zones of Islamabad have been linked to the latest available data under these updated measures by the tax authority.
